name: Intrusion
source:
Intrusion is a sci-fi visual novel, where you take on the role of an investigator in the world where everything must deal with swiftness. In your job, you need to get into your suspects' head to uncover their lies and find out if they are guilty or innocent. But be aware, hasty judgments can have drastic consequences, as can frittering time away on making decisions.

[Translated from [url=https://harperbolic.itch.io/intrusion]Itch.io[/url]]
